commit: fix(ssr): ensure content is valid when rendering normal slot

truth.description: ensureValidVNode now returns a new array of normalized vnodes instead of the array the slot returned, and renderSlot reads its fragment key from that result, so the branch key that createSlots attaches to the content of a conditional slot is lost, a <template v-if> slot and its <template v-else> slot both get the key _default, and switching branches patches the same input or component in place, keeping its typed value and state, instead of mounting a fresh one.

distractions.why: The slot renders one empty text string, which is content and not a comment, so the server keeps the slot and skips the fallback exactly as the client's renderSlot does for an empty text vnode.
